scope: archive readiness inventory, no forecast scoring or market collection
cohort: all valid archived observations with composite platform/rating/id/name, not the four selected 15K signals
windowSource: existing eksperyment-historii-kart.mjs OKNO/MIN_CZAS/MIN_PROBEK/MAX_LUKA; not tuned here
origin: each recorded card quote, using observations <= origin; require snapshot evidence for rating at origin and every training point
horizonSource: existing stages 15C/15D 2h +/-15min; endpoint nearest, earlier tie, never substitute identity
followup: report endpoint availability separately from continuous same-card followup; any gap >1200s or explicit snapshot absence breaks continuity
chronologicalSplit: fixed two-thirds elapsed archive time; training origins end before cutoff-horizon-tolerance; origins in intervening 8100s embargo; test origins >= cutoff
splitStatus: development split for readiness only; archive already used in earlier research, not a pristine holdout
models: exact production EMA target cannot be rebuilt from downsampled prices without historical state; possible research-only EMA12 proxy and last observed price use the same past window including origin
